items.claim: Goff will suffer a stoppage loss due to an accumulation of damage as the fight progresses.
items.quote: at some point I think it's just going to be an accumulation of damage with Goff where he's going to go down.

items.claim: Ty Miller is hittable and has defensive lapses during his tall man moments.
items.quote: Ty Miller can get hit. Let's be real about this thing. He's not an Uber spot prospect going to a title. He can be hit and he has those tall man moments.

items.claim: Darren Elkins is very tough but lacks high-level skills compared to others.
items.quote: Not nearly the most skilled guy in the cage ever, but just shows up
